failure_summary.description: Agents regenerated or merely retrieved cached results instead of filtering compatible cached results for the latest constraints.
Agents treated the return date as an arrival date instead of searching a separate reverse-direction flight leg.
An agent guessed missing hotel dates and applied an unstated budget to an independent restaurant search.
Nearest-result calls omitted the required grouping argument or included an unnecessary broader comparison.

patch.reasoning: The current skill already directly covers these failures: it requires cache retrieval and filtering, separate directional searches for round trips, validation of mandatory inputs, and an explicit groupBy for proximity calls. These trajectories show violations of existing instructions rather than a missing general rule, so adding duplicate guidance is not warranted.
